action.rationale: Fresh problem with budget 100, dim=5, and noisy evaluations; we should learn the landscape before committing. Probing at ~12% of the budget (~12 evals) will inform whether to use global restarts or local polish next.

Probes show wide value spread (log10_range=5.274) and well-dispersed top-10 (top10_spread_vs_uniform=0.8528), hinting at multiple basins, while FDC=0.5357 suggests exploitable structure. With dim=5, cheap, noisy evaluations and 93 evals left, a small race between robust, noise-tolerant global methods will identify the best driver efficiently. This hedges before committing large budget.

DE won the race and delivered the incumbent 2818.51 within 20 evals; it is now active with evals_in_tenure=0, so it hasn’t had a proper run yet. Probes suggest a noisy, multi-basin landscape (log10_range=5.274, top10_spread_vs_uniform=0.853), favoring a population method like DE. Continuing DE should leverage its momentum before considering restarts or switches.

DE has stalled (0.0 improvement over its 25-eval tenure, stall_evals=33) while we still have 38 evals left on a noisy problem. Turbo and CMA-ES only had 5 evals each in the initial race (4522.94 and 9698.05), which is inconclusive, so a small race hedges and may find a better basin.

Only 14 evaluations remain, so we should spend them on local refinement of the current best (y=1345.97 at eval 86). CMA-ES still has sigma=1.56 and popsize=8, indicating broader search that may not pay off within 14 evals. Bobyqa is a strong local DFO choice to squeeze improvement at the end on this 5D problem.
